title: BuildingPositionStatusRisk
description: Contract for Brain Migration Slice 5 — Stage 1 building-position status risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0 (same overall JSON Schema contract convention as the Slices 1-4 schemas; no breaking change, so no contract-version bump). Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain. Any copy elsewhere (e.g. vendored into the application repository) is a mechanically identical mirror, never independently edited.

BuildingPositionStatusInput.description: The raw p.facts.buildingPositionStatus value. This is an EXACT-EQUALITY rule against the single literal 'skipped' — every other value ('confirmed', an empty string, null, undefined, or an unrecognised/legacy value) must produce a null output. Deliberately not broadened to treat missing/unrecognised values as 'skipped'.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when the rule does not fire (buildingPositionStatus !== 'skipped').

text.const: The proposed building position has not yet been pinpointed on a site map, so orientation and clearances are not yet confirmed.
